note_from_owner:
Alam Gredeg is a stunning tourist destination known for its breathtaking natural beauty and diverse outdoor activities. Nestled in a picturesque landscape, it offers visitors a chance to connect with nature through various experiences.

One of the highlights of Alam Gredeg is its natural swimming pools, where crystal-clear waters invite guests to take a refreshing dip. Surrounded by lush greenery, these pools provide a serene escape and are perfect for relaxation.

The area is also home to several enchanting waterfalls. Visitors can hike through scenic trails to witness the cascading waters, capturing the perfect photo or simply enjoying the tranquil sounds of nature. The falls are ideal for those looking to cool off or enjoy a picnic nearb

Warisan leluhur yang tentu menjadi daya tarik utama wisatawan untuk berkunjung ke Bali, yaitu adat dan budaya, masih dipertahankan dan dipelihara, walaupun seiring waktu berjalan dengan kemoderenan jaman.

Setelah Indonesia merdeka dan Bangli sudah menjadi Daerah Kabupaten, Pengadilan di Bangli dilaksanakan oleh Pengadilan Negeri / ekonomi Cabang Denpasar dan lama kelamaan berubah menjadi Pengadilan / Ekonomi Cabang Klungkung.

Mengingat Bangli adalah daerah Kabupaten yang luas dan semakin lama penduduknya semakin padat maka pada Tahun 1973 berdirilah Pengadilan Negeri Bangli dan gedung yang ditempati masih meminjam. Sejak Tahun 1981 Pengadilan Negeri Bangli telah memiliki Gedung sendiri.

title: Bali Handara Gate
address: Jl. Raya Singaraja-Denpasar, Pancasari, Kec. Sukasada, Kabupaten Buleleng, Bali 81161
note_from_owner:
Bali Handara Gate is located in Pancasari Village Bedugul, the central highlands of Bali and nestled down inside the crater of an extinct volcano at an altitude of almost 1,400 meters (almost 4,000 feet) above sea level.

This is one of the most Instagrammed spot on the island. It's become a must-visit place among tourists and photography lover.

Handara Gate is actually the entrance to a golf resort. The traditional Hindu gate symbolises the entrance from the outer world to the temple, or in this case, golf course, and plays an important role in Indonesian culture, particularly in Bali.

title: Tabanan Anom Palace
address: Jl. Gunung Agung No.5, Dajan Peken, Kec. Tabanan, Kabupaten Tabanan, Bali 82113
note_from_owner: Puri Anom Tabanan is an ancient building from The Tabanan Kingdom era. Was build at 18 th century by the King Of I Gusti Ngurah Agung Tabanan for his son Prince I Gusti Ngurah Gede Banjar. The Main Palace Puri Agung Singasana Tabanan was destroyed by Dutch Colonial Troops at 1906 after The king and the crown Prince was killed (Puputan ) in Denpasar for denied to surender to the colonialism. Then two of Crown Princes of Tabanan moved to Puri Anom Tabanan, and maried to her cousin at this Palace. Now to preserve this historical site, the palace has been opened for cultural activity and cultural tourism.

Dcrepes adalah pelopor pertama produk crepes di Indonesia. Berdiri dibawah naungan PT. Jaddi Pastrisindo Gemilang pada tahun 1996 dengan lokasi pertama di Plaza Senayan, Jakarta. Dcrepes menyajikan beragam menu lezat yang disuka berbagi kalangan, mulai dari anak-anak sampai dewasa dengan harga yang terjangkau.

Dcrepes memiliki 3 varian menu andalan, yaitu Sweet Crepes seperti Nutella Cheese, Silverqueen dan Banana Choco Cheese. Savory Crepes dengan pilihan isian daging lezat seperti Chili Dog, Smoked Beef & Cheese dan Beef Yakiniku. Selain itu ada Ice Cream Crepes untuk para penggemar cold dessert dengan menu Strawberry Special dan Choco Lovers. Ketiga varian ini hadir dalam 3 tipe kulit crepes, Crispy, Savory dan Soft Crepes.

address: Jl. Monkey Forest, Ubud, Kecamatan Ubud, Kabupaten Gianyar, Bali 80571
note_from_owner:
The Monkey Forest in Ubud is a lush, enchanting sanctuary nestled in the heart of Bali. Officially known as the Sacred Monkey Forest Sanctuary, this sprawling reserve is home to hundreds of playful long-tailed macaques.
It serves not only as a wildlife haven but also as a site of spiritual and cultural significance, with ancient temples and sacred groves scattered throughout the forest.
Managed by the Management of Monkey Forest and Padangtegal village, the Monkey Forest is both a popular tourist destination and a vital center for conservation and local heritage, offering visitors a unique blend of natural beauty and cultural depth.

title: Setia Darma House of Mask and Puppets

street: Jalan Tegal Bingin, Banjar Tengkulak Tengah
note_from_owner:
The House of Masks and Puppets was initiated by Mr. Hadi Sunyoto, a businessman and cultural enthusiast assisted by the late Mr. Agustinus Prayitno, a lover of antiques and culture. Both of them has been collecting masks and puppets from different regions in Indonesia for the past years. Mr. Hadi decided to create a space to collect, preserve and spread the knowledge of the art form of masks and puppets. As a result, the House of Masks and Puppets was open 2006.
The use of the word house for the space is used to signify the space as a place for activities, just like a house is.

note_from_owner:
PERFORMED EVERY TUESDAY & FRIDAY EVENING AT 19:00
*Also performing every Sunday evening at 19:00 until 3 September 2023*

Ubud is the cultural centre of Bali and is famous for its dances, and Tanah Gajah Ubud is proud to host a dance troupe of between fifty and seventy boys and men from the local community who perform the Kecak dance.

The spectacular 30 minute-long Balinese Kecak and fire dance performances are held at Tanah Gajah Ubud's candle-lit outdoor amphitheatre, , followed by an opportunity for guests to take photos with the talented performers before heading to The Tempayan restaurant for the Royal Rijsttafel dinner experience.

ementerian Agraria dan Tata Ruang/ Badan Pertanahan Nasional

Sesuai Peraturan Presiden Republik Indonesia Nomor 17 Tahun 2015 tentang Kementerian Agraria dan Tata Ruang, Kementerian Agraria dan Tata Ruang (ATR) mempunyai tugas menyelenggarakan urusan pemerintahan di bidang agraria/pertanahan dan tata ruang untuk membantu Presiden dalam menyelenggarakan pemerintahan negara.
Dalam melaksanakan tugasnya, Kementerian ATR menyelenggarakan fungsi:

perumusan, penetapan, dan pelaksanaan kebijakan di bidang tata ruang, infrastruktur keagrariaan/pertanahan, hubungan hukum keagrariaan/pertanahan, penataan agraria/pertanahan, pengadaan tanah, pengendalian pemanfaatan ruang dan penguasaan tanah, serta penanganan masalah agraria/pertanahan, pemanfaatan

note_from_owner:
Bali Dewata, kami adalah perusahaan yang bergerak di seni dekoratif dan proyek kreatif di Desa Silakarang, 4 km selatan Ubud.

Secara historis, sejak abad ke-16 desa kami merupakan tempat tumbuhnya seniman ukiran dan arsitek tradisional yang mengerjakan seni dekoratif berkualitas tinggi di banyak Pura dan Istana di Bali.

Bali Dewata dimulai ketika kakek kami mengerjakan furniture kayu, gapura di Puri Klungkung serta beberapa Pura di Bali. Bali Dewata dengan antusias melanjutkan legasi itu, mengeksplorasi dan menciptakan sesuatu yang baru tanpa meninggalkan nilai-nilai lama.

Saat ini karya seni berkualitas tinggi bermedia kayu, batu, fiber glass dan beton sudah tersebar di Bali, serta dikirim ke seluruh dunia melalui kargo laut dan udara.

note_from_owner:
Puri Kauhan Ubud is one of Balinese cultural heritage which is located in the cultural heart of the Island of the Gods in Ubud, Gianyar.

Established since the 19th century, Puri Kauhan Ubud has become part of the history of Bali and Indonesia. Puri Kauhan Ubud keeps historical records, cultural stories, and Balinese literature in manuscripts made from coconut tree leaves – also known as Lontar.

We invite all parties to explore the history and culture of Bali and Indonesia at Puri Kauhan Ubud.

address: G753+2F7, Jl. Raya Sanggingan Jl. Raya Campuhan, Campuhan, Kedewatan, Kecamatan Ubud, Kabupaten Gianyar, Bali 80571
street: G753+2F7, Jl. Raya Sanggingan Jl. Raya Campuhan
note_from_owner:
Founded in 1975, the Neka Art Museum (NAM) is a cornerstone of cultural heritage in Bali. NAM spotlight both traditional and contemporary arts. NAM has an impressive collection of paintings, sculptures, photography, and Keris.

Established by JMK Suteja Neka and NGM Srimin, the museum celebrates Bali’s artistic diversity with works from Balinese, Indonesian, Asian, and Western artists inspired by the island’s natural beauty and vibrant culture.

Under PM Kardi Suteja and his family’s leadership, NAM has undergone a major revitalization with building renovations, reorganization of collections, and new cultural programs. Visitors can now enjoy hands-on workshops like Keris Making and Balinese Painting Classes, among others.

title: Agung Rai Museum of Art
address: Jl. Raya Pengosekan Ubud, Ubud, Kecamatan Ubud, Kabupaten Gianyar, Bali 80571
note_from_owner:
The ARMA Foundation in Bali, Indonesia, was established in 1996 to promote and preserve Balinese art and culture. The Foundation is the administrative arm for a complex that includes a world class museum, a center for visual and performing arts including a dance and music Sanggar, or informal school. Hundreds of children, teenagers and adults have benefited from the ARMA Sanggar, which ARMA makes available without cost to local families. Many of these children have gone on to perform in their communities as skilled dancers and musicians. But now the continuation of the ARMA Sanggar program is under serious pressure, due to the declining income from donations of tourists.

note_from_owner:
"Pasraman" bila diterjemahkan kedalam Bahasa Indonesia, berarti "Tempat Berkumpul".

"Puri" dalam Bahasa Indonesia memiliki arti "Kediaman Keluarga Keturunan Bangsawan".

Pasraman Puri Puncak Bangsal merupakan kediaman serta tempat berkumpul keluarga bangsawan diwilayah Banjar Gaji, Desa/Kelurahan Dalung, Kecamatan Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Provinsi Bali. Didalam kediaman ini terdapat situs bersejarah, yaitu Situs Lintas Agama dan Monumen Resimen Mahasiswa Ugraçena. Diseberang Pasraman Puri Puncak Bangsal ini terdapat pula bangunan bersejarah milik keluarga besar Puri Puncak Bangsal, yang diberi nama "Monumen Perjuangan Bangsal".

note_from_owner: Bale Banjar is a Balinese cultural hub that offers a unique and immersive experience into the rich traditions of Bali. Located in the heart of Nusa Dua, Bale Banjar is a place where visitors can come to learn about Balinese dance, music, art, and cuisine. The center offers a variety of classes and workshops, as well as regular performances by renowned Balinese artists. Bale Banjar is also a popular venue for private events, such as weddings and corporate gatherings. With its stunning architecture, lush gardens, and warm hospitality, Bale Banjar is the perfect place to experience the magic of Bali.

title: Objek Wisata Sangeh
address: Jl. Brahmana, Sangeh, Kec. Abiansemal, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80352
note_from_owner:
Obyek wisata kera dengan hutan palanya yang sudah berusia ratusan tahun. Obyek wisata ini dirintis pada tgl 1 Januari 1969.
Jenis-jenis satwa yang paling dominan dan mejadi ciri khas kawasan ini adalah kera abu-abu (Macaca faciculari) dimana populasinya berdasarkan inventarisasi tahun 1993 sebanyak 22 jenis antara lain : Alap-alap (Elanus hypoleucu), Elang (Halioaster Indus), Burung Hantu (Typte alba javanica), Terocok (Gouvier ahalis), Musang (Paradorurus hermaproditus), Kucing hutan (Felis bengalensis), Sendanglawe (Ciconia episcepus) dan lain sebagainya.
Sarana Wisata Alam

Hutan Pala Sangeh dihuni oleh kera abu ekor panjang (Macaca fascicularis) yang jumlahnya saat ini kurang lebih 600 ekor.

Informasi Penting Mengenai Melukat di Tempat Kami

Sarana Melukat: Pejati dan Canang Sari tersedia (20 set). Pejati bisa digunakan bersama dalam satu kelompok.

Perlengkapan Upacara: Tidak tersedia di lokasi, harap membawa sendiri.

Ketentuan untuk Umat Hindu:
* Tidak perlu reservasi.
* Bisa melakukan melukat secara mandiri.

Ketentuan untuk Non-Hindu:
* Reservasi wajib.
* Wajib menggunakan jasa pemandu untuk memahami alur dan makna prosesi melukat.
* Tersedia paket lengkap yang bisa dipilih.

Fasilitas:
Toilet hanya tersedia di area parkir, milik warga desa. Harap memberikan donasi Rp2.000.

For English-Speaking Visitors:
* Reservation is required.
* Only two English-speaking local guides are available, so you must book in advance

note_from_owner:
Manistutu Camping Ground di Jembrana adalah destinasi camping yang menawarkan pengalaman alam yang menakjubkan. Terletak di kawasan yang dikelilingi oleh pepohonan hijau dan pemandangan alam yang indah, tempat ini sangat cocok untuk pecinta alam dan petualangan.
Fasilitas
- Area Camping: Tersedia area luas untuk mendirikan tenda dengan akses mudah ke sumber air.
- Kamar Mandi dan Toilet:Fasilitas sanitasi yang bersih dan terawat.
- Tempat Berkumpul: Area untuk berkumpul dan bersosialisasi, dilengkapi dengan tempat duduk.
- Api Unggun: Tersedia area untuk membuat api unggun, ideal untuk berkumpul di malam hari.
Suasana
Suasana di Manistutu Camping Ground sangat tenang dan damai, jauh dari kebisingan kota. Suara alam, seperti kicauan burung

In evening we are inviting You to take a peaceful rest on the hill, with beatifull landscape.
We serve fresh indonesian food.
Also there You will find amenities like shower and toilet.

If You wish we can offer extreem ride in Jungle with bugee (jeep).

description.description_two: With vaulted ceilings and sitting areas, the contemporary rooms offer Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and minibars, as well as coffeemakers and balconies with garden or water views. There are also villas with private pools. Room service is available.
description.description_three: Breakfast is offered. There's a genteel restaurant, a coffee shop, an outdoor pool and a spa, as well as bike rentals. Activities such as fishing, village and national park tours can be arranged.

description_arr: Overlooking Waduk Palasari reservoir, this tropical resort is 2.6 km from Gereja Palasari palace and 26 km from Taman Nasional Bali Barat, Bali's only national park.

With vaulted ceilings and sitting areas, the contemporary rooms offer Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and minibars, as well as coffeemakers and balconies with garden or water views. There are also villas with private pools. Room service is available.
Breakfast is offered. There's a genteel restaurant, a coffee shop, an outdoor pool and a spa, as well as bike rentals. Activities such as fishing, village and national park tours can be arranged.

note_from_owner:
Mal Pelayanan Publik (MPP) Kabupaten Jembrana adalah sebuah fasilitas yang menyediakan berbagai layanan publik di satu lokasi. MPP ini bertujuan untuk mempermudah masyarakat dalam mengakses berbagai layanan dari berbagai instansi pemerintah, baik di tingkat daerah maupun pusat. Di MPP Kabupaten Jembrana, terdapat instansi yang bergabung memberikan layanan, termasuk organisasi perangkat daerah (OPD) dan instansi vertikal.

MPP ini berlokasi di Jalan Udayana No. 16, Kelurahan Balar Bale Agung, Kecamatan Negara, Jembrana. Fasilitas ini dirancang untuk memberikan pelayanan yang lebih efektif dan efisien kepada masyarakat

note_from_owner:
Puri Agung Negara, Jembrana, salah satu puri yang bersejarah yang bertahan di Bali. Puri yang berada di wilayah Kelurahan Banjar Tengah, Kecamatan Negara, Jembrana, ini, merupakan rumah Anak Agung Bagus Sutedja, Gubernur Bali pertama dan dua kali memimpin Bali.
Puri Agung Negara adalah sebuah istana yang terletak di Kabupaten Jembrana, Bali. Bangunan ini merupakan pusat pemerintahan dan simbol budaya bagi masyarakat setempat. Puri ini memiliki arsitektur tradisional Bali yang khas, dengan ornamen-ornamen yang indah dan detail yang mencerminkan seni dan budaya Bali.

Di dalam Puri Agung Negara, pengunjung dapat melihat berbagai ruangan yang digunakan untuk upacara adat, pertemuan, dan kegiatan budaya lainnya.
